chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Ala', who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who prays the first two rak'ahs of an obligatory prayer and does not sit in them until he bows in the third. He said: Let him complete his salat, then let him give salam, and perform the two sajdahs of forgetfulness while seated before he speaks.

key_terms.سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ: the two prostrations performed for forgetfulness in prayer
key_terms.صَلَاتَهُ: his salat, meaning the prayer he is performing
key_terms.يَرْكَعَ: to bow in ruku' during the prayer
key_terms.يُسَلِّمْ: to conclude the prayer with salam

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets the first tashahhud and remembers only after bowing in the third rak'ah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who forgets the first tashahhud and only realizes after bowing in the third rak'ah of an obligatory salat. He should complete the prayer, then after salam perform the two sajdahs of forgetfulness before speaking.
